title: The Mammoth Calf
text: A mammoth calf, lost in the snow, its red fur caked with ice, crying for its mother in long, sad bellows. It is as big as a horse and still a baby. In the distance, the ground shakes, and shakes again, coming closer.

options.label: Lead the calf toward the shaking, and trust its mother to understand.

outcomes.text: Its mother finds it, and lets you walk in the shelter of her bulk.
Its mother finds you first, and she does not see a rescue.

options.label: Hide in the snow until they pass, and keep very still.

outcomes.text: A whole herd, and a long, freezing wait, and your kit stiff with ice by the end.

options.label: The shrewdest says a calf's tusks fetch a price, and the herd is far off yet.

outcomes.text: They do. The herd hears the calf stop crying, and the herd remembers.
